facts.fact: Bowmans partner Melissa Cogger writes that South Africa does not yet have a dedicated AI Act, and that the August 2024 AI Policy Framework is not binding legislation.

facts.fact: Bowmans partner Melissa Cogger writes that the government published the National Artificial Intelligence Policy Framework in August 2024, a non-binding statement of its strategic vision for AI governance.
